sponsored.t: Establishes a direct service professional credit and career ladder tuition assistance grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a direct service professional credit and career ladder tuition assistance grant program to develop training programs and improve existing workforce development programs for the purpose of training direct support professionals and establishing a career ladder for individuals working with individuals with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Essential Health Care Access Protection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Essential Health Care Access Protection act" under which the enforcement of certain restrictive covenants against health care professionals is prohibited when such enforcement may impair essential health care services.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "motorized recreational vehicle identification and accountability act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "motorized recreational vehicle identification and accountability act" in relation to requiring the registration and visible identification of certain motorized recreational and personal mobility vehicles.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sales tax exemption for the purchase of electric wheelchair accessible vehicles
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sales tax exemption for the purchase of electric vehicles that are designed for the purpose of transporting persons in wheelchairs or containing any physical device or alteration designed to permit access to and enable the transportation of persons in wheelchairs.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state take me home program within the division of criminal justice services
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state take me home program within the division of criminal justice services; directs the division of criminal justice services to create a secure, voluntary statewide emergency information registry to allow participants to provide information, before an emergency occurs, about individuals who may be at increased risk of wandering, becoming lost or having difficulty communicating during an emergency to assist first responders to locate and assist such individuals in the case of an emergency.

sponsored.t: Establishes the statewide group home families working group
sponsored.sum: Establishes the statewide group home families working group; provides that duties include informing and advising the commissioner as to matters of importance for persons with developmental disabilities residing in group homes and their families and guardians, providing recommendations for statewide and regional priorities and goals for individuals residing in group homes and families and guardians of individuals residing in group homes, advising the commissioner on such other matters related to group homes as the statewide group home families working group deems relevant, holding regional public meetings to solicit and receive input from residents of group homes and family members and…

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting county correction officers from dispensing medications to incarcerated individuals on the premises of a local correctional facility
sponsored.sum: Prohibits county correction officers from dispensing medications to incarcerated individuals on the premises of a local correctional facility; provides that correction officers or staff may dispense or administer medications during a medical emergency, or dispense nonprescription medication.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state rural ambulance services task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state rural ambulance services task force to conduct annual studies on the availability of ambulance services in rural areas and to make recommendations upon the findings of such studies; requires the department of health to submit an annual report detailing the findings of such studies.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the office for people with developmental disabilities to issue a residential request list and placement report
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to issue a residential request list and placement report to the governor, the senate and the assembly.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Jason Dutcher
sponsored.sum: Provides that Jason Dutcher, an employee of the New York state police and currently a Tier VI member of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system, shall be granted a date of membership with such retirement system of December 10, 2008 if he shall file a written request with the state comptroller within one year.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prohibition of lending institutions issuing unsolicited mail-loan checks
sponsored.sum: Relates to the prohibition of lending institutions issuing mail-loan checks except in response to an affirmative request or application therefor; provides that any debt, interest, fee or other obligation arising from a mail-loan check issued in violation of this section shall be null and void and unenforceable.

sponsored.t: Relates to defining "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption
sponsored.sum: Defines "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption.

sponsored.t: Provides that priority shall be given to certain sites when developing renewable energy generating projects
sponsored.sum: Provides that priority shall be given to certain sites when developing renewable energy generating projects; defines "agrivoltaics".

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program to improve equity and efficiency in housing for people with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program in partnership with a nonprofit organization to improve equity and efficiency in housing for people with developmental disabilities by encouraging shared housing.

sponsored.t: Directs the office for people with developmental disabilities to conduct a study on housing models that support independent living for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the office for people with developmental disabilities to conduct a study on the feasibility of establishing, implementing and expanding additional housing models that support independent living for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities; requires the office to submit a report on such study to the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly.

sponsored.t: Relates to residential transition conferences and the placement of persons with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Requires covered operators to provide written notice of pending placement of persons with developmental disabilities to interested parties; specifies who may be considered an interested party; provides that a residential transition conference shall be held between the interested parties after notice has been given of the proposed placement to discuss the proposal.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring navigation systems which utilize GPS technology to provide the actual height of bridges and overpasses along proposed routes
sponsored.sum: Requires navigation systems which utilize GPS technology to provide the legal clearance of bridges or elevated structures along proposed routes.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the availability of no-fee basic banking accounts for consumers
sponsored.sum: Provides that every banking institution operating in the state of New York shall offer at least one no-fee basic banking account that charges no monthly maintenance or service fees, requires no minimum balance, charges no fees based on account inactivity, and provides certain essential services including deposits and withdrawals, debit card access, and electronic payments and transfers.

sponsored.t: Establishes the blue-ribbon commission on the future of New York state's service delivery system for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "blue-ribbon commission on the future of New York state's service delivery system for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities act" to conduct a study and prepare a report to examine, evaluate and make recommendations for systemic reforms to ensure a sustainable set of supports and services that meets the evolving needs of all individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes self-station gas stations to allow hands-free gas dispensing
sponsored.sum: Authorizes self-service gas stations to allow for hands-free gas dispensing by installing hold open clips on gasoline and diesel fuel dispensing nozzles.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the town of Rotterdam
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the town of Rotterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "smart meter transparency and consumer protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "smart meter transparency and consumer protection act" in relation to requiring utilities to provide certain information about smart meters to customers; authorizes and directs the public service commission, in coordination with an independent third party, to conduct a study on smart meter implementation in New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to social admission of certain minors presenting to hospitals for mental or behavioral health concerns who are medically cleared for discharge, when such minor is abandoned at the hospital
sponsored.sum: Establishes procedures for the social admission of certain minors presenting to emergency departments for mental or behavioral health evaluation when a parent, legal guardian, or local social services district refuses to retrieve the minor upon discharge.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum regulations for the design and construction of new homes to provide visitability to such homes by persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Requires access to new homes by persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing civil penalties for improper denial of propane service by propane companies
sponsored.sum: Establishes civil penalties for a propane company's improper denial of propane service to consumers located in such propane company's designated service territory; provides for enforcement of such penalties by the department of public service and the office of the attorney general; directs that such civil penalties be deposited into the New York state general fund.

sponsored.t: Ensures fairness in organ donations to persons with physical or mental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Prevents discrimination against persons with physical or mental disabilities in regards to organ donations.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for treatments to slow the progression of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias
sponsored.sum: Provides for coverage for treatments to slow the progression of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing lead exposure in school drinking water through risk-based certified point-of-use filtration
sponsored.sum: Directs school districts and boards of cooperative educational services to implement certified point-of-use lead removal filtration devices when an elevated risk for lead exposure is identified; allows for the discontinuance of use of such filtration devices once certain requirements are met.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing civil penalties for failure of propane providers to deliver emergency service under automatic refill contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing civil penalties for failure of propane providers to deliver emergency service under automatic refill contracts, providing for enforcement by the department of public service and the office of the attorney general, and directing that all collected civil penalties be deposited into the New York state general fund.

sponsored.t: Requires all state and private agencies with mandatory reporters of incidents involving vulnerable people to retrain all staff on reporting to a 9-1-1 operator and the county district attorney's office
sponsored.sum: Requires all state and private agencies with mandatory reporters of incidents involving vulnerable people to retrain all staff on reporting to a 9-1-1 operator and the county district attorney's office and state and private websites; requires written materials to be updated.

sponsored.t: Establishes daylight saving time as the year-round standard time of the state and the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes daylight saving time as the year-round standard time of the state and the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes a propane consumer pricing advisor and propane advisory board
sponsored.sum: Establishes the position of propane consumer pricing advisor and a propane advisory board within the department of public service.

sponsored.t: Relates to subcontracted facilitators of the statewide fiscal intermediary
sponsored.sum: Relates to subcontracted facilitators of the statewide fiscal intermediary.

sponsored.t: Enacts the employer-assisted housing matching grant act
sponsored.sum: Creates an employer-assisted housing match grant program under which certain nonprofit employees may be eligible for a state match for certain employer-provided funds for housing costs.

sponsored.t: Enacts the care workforce housing preference act
sponsored.sum: Provides for the eligibility of certain households for a care workforce housing preference; provides for the method of application for such preference; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Includes "people with disabilities" within the definition of "minority"
sponsored.sum: Requires the definition of "minority" to include "people with disabilities" pursuant to the Human Rights law in order for such people with disabilities to be eligible for state contract set asides.

sponsored.t: Enacts the CareForce first-time homebuyers act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the CareForce first-time homebuyers program under which certain first-time homebuyers may receive below-market mortgage financing and forgivable down payment assistance.

sponsored.t: Permits the establishment of reserve funds for costs relating to special education
sponsored.sum: Permits the establishment of reserve funds for unanticipated costs relating to special education, provided that the amount in such fund shall not exceed four percent of the district's current school year budget.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal impersonation by electronic communication and emergency disclosure of caller-identification routing information
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of criminal electronic impersonation and aggravated criminal electronic impersonation; requires certain voice-over internet, call-routing and electronic communication services to preserve certain call routing and originating connection records and to provide such records to law enforcement upon request.

sponsored.t: Enacts the employer-assisted housing matching grant act
sponsored.sum: Creates an employer-assisted housing match grant program under which certain nonprofit employees may be eligible for a state match for certain employer-provided funds for housing costs.

sponsored.t: Enacts the care workforce housing preference act
sponsored.sum: Provides for the eligibility of certain households for a care workforce housing preference; provides for the method of application for such preference; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to small business energy assistance and advocacy services
sponsored.sum: Relates to small business energy assistance and advocacy services; establishes the small business energy assistance and advocacy services program within the division for small-business; authorizes the division for small-business to initiate complaints to the public service commission regarding gas and electricity and steam heat.

sponsored.t: Relates to the computation of building aid for the Schenectady city school district
sponsored.sum: Relates to the computation of building aid for construction, reconstruction or modernizing of no more than one project by the Schenectady city school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting certain marketing strategies that result in excess waste
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain marketing strategies intended to solicit a subscription to a commercial service by attaching wasteful additional materials to a formal letter.

sponsored.t: Relates to employment by the state of persons with autism spectrum disorder
sponsored.sum: Provides that the civil service commission may determine that one in every thirty-six positions with duties which can be performed by persons with autism spectrum disorder.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Prader-Willi syndrome residential stabilization and best-practice support act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Prader-Willi syndrome residential stabilization and best-practice support act" in relation to providing services to individuals with Prader-Willi syndrome.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of vehicle-mounted variable message signs by emergency roadside service vehicles, tow trucks and highway assistance vehicles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of vehicle-mounted variable message signs on emergency road service vehicles, tow trucks and highway assistance vehicles when such vehicles are responding to roadside emergencies or disabled vehicles, only for safety-related communications.

sponsored.t: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual comprehensive summary of information about its activities to the office for people with developmental disabilities' website
sponsored.sum: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual comprehensive summary of information about its activities to the office for people with developmental disabilities' website, in an accessible format.

sponsored.t: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have electronic monitoring devices in the common areas of their residential facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have electronic monitoring devices in the common areas of their residential facilities.

sponsored.t: Requires providers of residential services to developmentally disabled children to have surveillance cameras in the common areas of their residential facilities
Revokes the public pension of a public officer who stands convicted on an impeachment
sponsored.sum: Revokes the public pension of a public officer who stands convicted on an impeachment; applies retroactively.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "emergency school relief act of 2026"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "emergency school relief act"; makes changes in the percentages for disposition of revenue from lottery prize account to increase the percentage directed to state aid for education funding.

sponsored.t: Relates to services for post-traumatic stress disorder for emergency dispatchers and correction officers
sponsored.sum: Requires the same benefits and services for post-traumatic stress disorder for emergency dispatchers and correction officers as are afforded police and firefighters.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "student safety, parent notification, and transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "student safety, parent notification, and transparency act" in relation to parent notification, documentation, review, and reporting required when physical restraint or force is used on a student.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to CW2 John M. Grassia III
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a bridge on I-88 in the town of Rotterdam to CW2 John M. Grassia III.

sponsored.t: Establishes the transitional pathway program for students in higher education with autism spectrum disorder
sponsored.sum: Establishes the transitional pathway program for students in higher education at SUNY and CUNY schools with autism spectrum disorder to encourage accessibility and inclusivity in higher education for students with autism spectrum disorder; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Suspends fees in connection with a REAL ID driver's license until 2027
sponsored.sum: Suspends fees in connection with a REAL ID driver's license or non-driver ID card until 2027; refunds fees paid since 2017.

sponsored.t: Relates to sentencing for the crime of aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to sentencing for the crime of aggravated cruelty to animals; removes the two year imprisonment cap.

sponsored.t: Exempts active volunteer firefighters from jury duty
sponsored.sum: Exempts active volunteer firefighters from jury duty when such firefighter files a form, prescribed by the chief administrator of the courts, with the appropriate commissioner of jurors.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to make purchases from other municipalities' contracts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to make purchases from other municipalities' contracts.

sponsored.t: Creates a moratorium on the annexation of agricultural land by localities for an industrial use
sponsored.sum: Creates a moratorium on the annexation of agricultural land by certain localities for an industrial use for one year.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the New York Department of State from issuing a certificate of dissolution and filing a judgment or final order of dissolution for the pension fund for employees of the former St. Clare's Hospital
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the New York Department of State from issuing a certificate of dissolution and filing a judgment or final order of dissolution for the pension fund for employees of the former St. Clare's Hospital in the city of Schenectady, county of Schenectady, until an investigation and/or audit by the New York State Department of Health, the New York State Attorney General or the New York State Comptroller has been conducted to ascertain whether there was any impropriety in the handling and management of funds in such pension plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating autism teams in hospitals
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating autism teams in hospitals; requires the department of health to design a pilot program to develop one "autism team" who may be called upon should a patient with autism come to a hospital; provides that members of the autism team shall be knowledgeable about autism and communication difficulties many people with autism have and advise physicians and other staff on how to communicate with patients with autism.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative approval of increases in utility charges
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "utility ratepayer protection act"; requires legislative approval of increases in utility charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice to the commander of a military station of certain municipal actions
sponsored.sum: Relates to notice to the commander of a military station of certain municipal actions that occur within 3000 feet of the property to be affected by the proposed action.

sponsored.t: Establishes March 13 as a day of commemoration to be known as "K9 Veterans Day"
sponsored.sum: Establishes March 13 as a day of commemoration to be known as "K9 Veterans Day".

sponsored.t: Provides that students who have an IEP shall not be required to take more than one regents examination in any given day
sponsored.sum: Provides that students who have an IEP shall not be required to take more than one regents examination on any given day.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and duties of the advisory council of the justice center for the protection of people with special needs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the powers and duties of the advisory council of the justice center for the protection of people with special needs; adds additional duties relating to investigations of allegations of abuse and neglect.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an electronic monitoring program for certain children and adults
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an electronic monitoring program for certain children and adults; establishes a program where local law enforcement agencies shall provide electronic monitoring devices to parents or guardians to be worn by children or adults with autism spectrum disorder, developmental disability, Alzheimer's disease or other dementia, or any other cognitive disorder; provides such devices shall be used by law enforcement agencies to locate missing children or adults.

sponsored.t: Relates to flags sold in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires any American flag and New York state flag sold in New York state to be manufactured in the United States.

sponsored.t: Establishes a moratorium on the placement of registered sex offenders by the office for people with developmental disabilities in residential placements for individuals with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a moratorium on the placement of registered sex offenders by the office for people with developmental disabilities in residential placements for individuals with developmental disabilities; requires the office to study the dangers and effects of such placements and whether there are any other alternatives to such placements and to report to the governor and the legislature on its findings and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Requires cable companies to charge the same rate for the same service
sponsored.sum: Requires cable companies to charge the same rate for the same service to different subscribers.

sponsored.t: Excludes fundraising from consideration in appropriating state aid and reimbursement for services to volunteer ambulance companies
sponsored.sum: Excludes fundraising from consideration in appropriating state aid and reimbursement for services to volunteer ambulance companies, including regional emergency medical councils.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of locomotive horns at private highway-rail grade crossings; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of locomotive horns at private highway-rail grade crossings; establishes use of locomotive horn in the locomotive engineer's sole judgment, is appropriate in order to prevent imminent injury, death, or property damage.

sponsored.t: Establishes the small farm disaster recovery grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small farm disaster recovery grant program; provides grants for the purchase and replanting of crops destroyed by natural disaster.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of a standardized immunization exemption form
sponsored.sum: Directs the use of a standardized immunization exemption form; requires the commissioner of health to develop a standardized medical immunization exemption request form for school use.

sponsored.t: Prevents fees from being charged for the issuance of certain license plates
sponsored.sum: Prevents fees from being charged for the issuance of license plates where the vehicle has legible plates.

sponsored.t: Relates to obligations with respect to contracts with business enterprises which employ individuals with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to obligations with respect to contracts with business enterprises which employ individuals with disabilities; defines qualified business enterprise as any business concern which employs a workforce consisting of at least fifteen percent employees with disabilities and has been certified under this section; sets goal of five percent of state contracts going to qualified business enterprises; establishes an office of statewide advocate, certification process, and enforcement mechanism.

sponsored.t: Imposes a five-day time limit during which to disclose a breach in the security of a system
sponsored.sum: Relates to imposing a five-day time limit during which to disclose a breach in the security of a system.

sponsored.t: Allows livestock owners to directly purchase killed rabies vaccine for the purpose of vaccinating livestock owned by such livestock owner
sponsored.sum: Allows livestock owners to purchase and possess rabies vaccine and to vaccinate their livestock against rabies during emergency rabies outbreak situations as determined by the commissioner of health; provides for the expiration and repeal of such provisions after two years; defines livestock for the purpose of this section.

sponsored.t: Provides for a mandatory ten-year minimum sentence of imprisonment for certain felony convictions of public servants
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing for a mandatory ten-year minimum sentence of imprisonment for certain felony convictions of public servants.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway as the "John M. Grassia III Memorial Bridge"
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of state route one hundred fifty-nine in the town of Rotterdam, county of Schenectady, as the "John M. Grassia III Memorial Bridge".

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for multi-formatted services menus for the cognitively impaired on websites operated by certain state agencies
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing for multi-formatted services menus for the cognitively impaired on websites operated by certain state agencies; includes the department of health, office for people with developmental disabilities and the office of mental health.

sponsored.t: Requires the state athletic commission to promulgate regulations for authorized combined professional and amateur mixed martial arts events
sponsored.sum: Requires the state athletic commission to promulgate regulations for authorized combined professional and amateur mixed martial arts events no later than June 30, 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to unclaimed lottery prizes
sponsored.sum: Requires unclaimed lottery prizes to be paid into the state treasury, to the credit of the state lottery fund.

sponsored.t: Exempts sales of bottled water from sales and use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts retail sales of bottled water from the imposition of sales and use taxes.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York thruway authority to develop and implement a toll discount program waiving additional costs for tolls related to travel on the New York state thruway for certain individuals
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York thruway authority to develop and implement a toll discount program waiving additional costs for tolls related to travel on the New York state thruway for certain individuals who do not maintain an E-Z Pass account.

sponsored.t: Establishes an employment of New York national guard and reserve members wage tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for companies that employ New York national guard and reserve members in an amount equal to fifteen hundred dollars for each national guard or reserve member employed by such employer and twenty-five hundred dollars for each national guard or reserve member employed by such employer who has completed or returned from a deployment or activation.

sponsored.t: Grants a sales and compensating use tax exemption for the sale of items designed to ensure the safe handling and storage of firearms
sponsored.sum: Grants a sales and compensating use tax exemption for the sale of items designed to ensure the safe handling and storage of firearms including safe storage depositories, firearm safety locks and trigger locks.

sponsored.t: Relates to affordable housing for persons with a disability or having attained the age of sixty-two
sponsored.sum: Relates to affordable housing for persons with a disability or having attained the age of sixty-two; establishes a developmentally disabled and elderly adult accessory apartment loan program.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring approval by the comptroller for a toll increase by the New York state thruway authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring approval by the comptroller for a toll increase by the New York state thruway authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice of quorum requirements at zoning board of appeals and planning board meetings
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing notice of quorum requirements to applicants for building or site permits, variances, or subdivision plats at zoning board of appeals, local planning board, county planning board, and regional planning council meetings.

sponsored.t: Enacts the college textbook affordability act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the college textbook affordability act; establishes the New York state open education resources council and the New York state open source digital library; authorizes SUNY campuses and community colleges to adopt open educational resources adoption incentive program campus plans and apply for grants to implement such plans; provides that settlements with the office of the attorney general shall be used to provide assistance to the state university of New York for the purposes of carrying out the provisions of this act.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the issuance of "Blue Star Mother" and "Blue Star Family" distinctive license plates and establishes the "blue star mothers and families fund"
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the issuance of "Blue Star Mother" and "Blue Star Family" distinctive license plates for parents and family members of active duty service members; establishes the "blue star mothers and families support fund".

sponsored.t: Establishes a right of first refusal in the state for federal public land to be transferred
sponsored.sum: Establishes a right of first refusal in the state for federal public land to be transferred to private parties; prohibits the recording of any deeds for lands that have been transferred out of federal ownership to private ownership without giving the state the right of first refusal.

sponsored.t: Raises the jurisdictional amount for small claims cases
sponsored.sum: Raises the jurisdictional amount for small claims cases from $3,000 to $10,000 in justice court.

sponsored.t: Provides lifetime, premium-free insurance through the New York state of health marketplace to a person who donates a kidney during the course of their lifetime
sponsored.sum: Provides lifetime, premium-free insurance through the New York state of health marketplace to a person who donates a kidney during the course of their lifetime; establishes the kidney donor insurance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to background clearances for prospective employees and volunteers of mentoring programs
sponsored.sum: Permits mentoring programs to conduct background clearances of prospective employees and volunteers to determine whether any such person has been reported for child abuse or maltreatment or is on the sex offender registry.

sponsored.t: Establishes mandatory training for every high school guidance counselor relating to assisting students with autism spectrum disorder
sponsored.sum: Establishes mandatory training for every high school guidance counselor relating to assisting students with autism spectrum disorder; requires high school guidance counselors to receive training at least once a year on the special needs of students with autism spectrum disorder and how to assist such students in the transition from high school to higher education or employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees charged for the issuance of number plates and to requiring a report on the costs of manufacturing such plates
sponsored.sum: Relates to fees charged for the issuance of number plates and to requiring a report on the costs of manufacturing such plates; requires the fee for a number plate not to exceed the cost of producing such plate; establishes that no additional fee shall be charged to keep a current number plate due to a design change implemented by the commissioner; requires the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision to report on the costs of manufacturing license plates.

sponsored.t: Relates to the production of and the assessment of a surcharge for distinctive Feeling Rural Good license plates and to establishing the feeling rural good health care fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to the production of and the assessment of a surcharge for distinctive "Feeling Rural Good" license plates; establishes the feeling rural good health care fund; provides that funds deposited into the feeling rural good health care fund shall be used in rural regions of the state to expand school-based health programs, improve access to health research and education, and expand broadband access for improved access to telehealth.

sponsored.t: Provides that where the commissioner of health assumes the responsibility for the transportation of medicaid recipients in rural areas, existing public transportation systems shall be used
sponsored.sum: Provides that where the commissioner of health assumes the responsibility for the transportation of medicaid recipients in rural areas, existing public transportation systems shall be used when such systems are appropriate, available and the least expensive modes of transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to exemptions available to veterans
sponsored.sum: Relates to exemptions available to veterans; requires school districts to provide the veterans alternative exemption; establishes that costs associated with such exemption shall be borne by the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of profits from commissaries or canteens in county correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Allows county correctional facilities to use the profits from commissaries or canteens within the facilities for the general purposes of the institution.

sponsored.t: Designates the Honor and Remember Flag as the official state flag for recognizing armed services members
sponsored.sum: Designates the "Honor and Remember Flag" as the official state flag for recognizing armed service members who have died as a result of serving the United States in any war or conflict the nation has been involved in since its inception.

sponsored.t: Establishes the customized employment demonstration program whereby certain positions are divided into sub-positions by the civil service commission to provide for employment of disabled persons
sponsored.sum: Establishes the customized employment demonstration program whereby certain positions are divided into sub-positions by the civil service commission to provide for employment of persons with developmental disabilities who are able to perform a portion of the duties of such position.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a personal income tax deduction for home heating expenses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a personal income tax deduction for expenses paid during the taxable year by a qualified taxpayer attributable to the cost of residential heating, including, but not limited to amounts paid for fuel oil, coal, wood, propane, natural gas, electricity, steam, kerosene and any other fuel used to heat such taxpayer's primary residence.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of bingo games
sponsored.sum: Authorizes housing authorities to operate bingo games; adds guests invited by residents of any apartment, condominium or cooperative complex, housing authority, retirement community, or other group residential complex or facility to the scope of application; allows games to be conducted two days per week; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Eliminates certain will filing fees
sponsored.sum: Eliminates filing fees for wills filed for safekeeping in the surrogate's court.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York autism spectrum disorders treatment, training and research council and provides for the powers and duties of the council
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York autism spectrum disorders treatment, training and research council; provides for the powers and duties of the council.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation in games of bingo by minors
sponsored.sum: Permits participation in games of bingo by minors who are accompanied by an adult.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state autism council
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state autism council; establishes such council shall consist of sixteen members; establishes the duties of the council.

sponsored.t: Requires an independent firm to conduct a study on the OPWDD eligibility criteria and determinations following diagnostic evaluations by a licensed professional and distribution of services
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to work with an independent firm to allow such firm to conduct a study on the OPWDD eligibility criteria and determinations following diagnostic evaluations by a licensed professional and distribution of services.

sponsored.t: Enacts the internet service outage consumer protection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "internet service outage consumer protection act"; requires every internet service provider operating in this state to issue a prorated bill credit to consumers for any internet service outage lasting more than one hour.

sponsored.t: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation
sponsored.sum: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation.

sponsored.t: Requires school bus drivers and attendants who ride with children attending preschool special education programs to complete training
sponsored.sum: Requires school bus drivers and attendants who ride with children attending preschool special education programs to complete training in the needs of such children.

sponsored.t: Relates to including at least one person who is familiar with the needs of students with disabilities in the development of school safety plans
sponsored.sum: Relates to including at least one person who is familiar with the needs of students with disabilities in the development of school safety plans; provides that building-level response plans shall include a list including each student with a disability enrolled at the site together with information from the student's individualized education program (IEP) that is relevant to ensuring the student's safety and the role of the staff member responsible for assisting the student in an emergency.

sponsored.t: Removes the additional service charge for distinctive Elks Association license plates
sponsored.sum: Removes the additional $25 service charge for distinctive Elks Association license plates.

sponsored.t: Prohibits food service establishments from using a dynamic pricing model in determining the prices on its menu
sponsored.sum: Prohibits food service establishments from using a dynamic pricing model in determining the prices on its menu; requires fixed prices be published on a food service establishment's menu.

sponsored.t: Relates to taxpayer publicly funded research
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "taxpayer access to publicly funded research act"; defines terms; requires each agency that provides funding for direct research shall develop a public access policy.

sponsored.t: Requires a certified copy or certified transcript of a birth record, death record, certificate of marriage, or certificate of dissolution of marriage to be issued to the child, grandchild, or great-grandchild
sponsored.sum: Requires a certified copy or certified transcript of a birth record, death record, certificate of marriage, or certificate of dissolution of marriage to be issued to the child, grandchild, or great-grandchild of a deceased person upon request; removes requirement for such individuals to obtain a court order for issuance of such records.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the acquisition or transfer of agricultural land by foreign adversaries
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the acquisition or transfer of agricultural land by foreign adversaries after January 1, 2026; provides that such prohibition will not apply to any interest in agricultural land held by a foreign adversary prior to such date or any federally recognized Indian tribe or its government units and enterprises; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of county court judges in Schenectady county
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of county court judges in Schenectady county from one judge to two.

sponsored.t: Relates to excusing prospective jurors from jury service if they are a full-time caregiver responsible for the care of a person with a mental or physical condition
sponsored.sum: Excuses prospective jurors from jury service if they are a full-time caregiver responsible for the care of a person with a mental or physical condition that causes such person to be incapable of caring for themself.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the COVID-19 children scholarship
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the COVID-19 children scholarship; provides that children whose parent, primary caretaker or sibling died or was disabled as a result of contracting COVID-19 shall be eligible for such scholarship.

sponsored.t: Provides for a formal process for a parent or legal guardian to request the issuance of an AMBER alert
sponsored.sum: Provides for a formal process for a parent or legal guardian to request the issuance of an AMBER alert.

sponsored.t: Includes pensions from a defined benefit plan in the exclusion from federal adjusted gross income
sponsored.sum: Includes pensions from a defined benefit plan in the exclusion from federal adjusted gross income.

sponsored.t: Relates to sufficient proof that a student enrolled in or admitted to an institution of higher education has a disability
sponsored.sum: Requires institutions of higher education to implement a policy that documentation of an individualized education program (IEP) is sufficient proof that a student enrolled in or admitted to an institution of higher education has a disability.

sponsored.t: Relates to grand larceny in the fourth degree
sponsored.sum: Adds a person having been previously convicted of petit larceny two times within any three month period or three times within any twelve month period to the definition of grand larceny in the fourth degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes a program of tiered eligibility for services offered by OPWDD for persons with learning disabilities and other complex neurological impairments
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program of tiered eligibility for services offered by the office for people with developmental disabilities for persons with learning disabilities and other complex neurological impairments.

sponsored.t: Establishes requirements for resettling, transporting or relocating certain migrants to other municipalities
sponsored.sum: Imposes consultation and reporting requirements for municipal corporations resettling, transporting or relocating non-detained migrants to another municipal corporation within the state, which is directed, administered, or funded by the federal government, the secretary of health and human services in the case of minors, the secretary of homeland security in the case of adults, or any municipal corporation within the state or agents thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers to provide information on resources for insureds or enrollees recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to provide information on resources for insureds or enrollees recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.

sponsored.t: Requires operators of motor vehicles to reduce their speed when approaching and passing mobile ice cream vendor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires operators of motor vehicles to reduce their speed when approaching and passing mobile ice cream vendor vehicles when such vendor vehicle is parked and in active operation.

sponsored.t: Creates a live kidney donor follow-up study
sponsored.sum: Creates a ten year live kidney donor follow-up study which includes a one thousand dollars per year stipend for participants; provides two thousand dollars for all kidney donors for health-related expenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to information cable television companies must provide to subscribers
sponsored.sum: Relates to information cable television companies must provide to subscribers regarding availability of required equipment at retail.

sponsored.t: Amends the definition of "developmental disability"
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of "developmental disability" to include an inability to engage in any substantial gainful activity by reason of the disability.

sponsored.t: Establishes a registry to help locate individuals with autism, Alzheimer's and dementia in the event they go missing
sponsored.sum: Establishes a voluntary registry of individuals with autism, Alzheimer's or dementia who may be at risk of wandering away from home; creates a standardized form available that may be submitted to local law enforcement agencies by family members and caregivers of such individuals that would include identifying information and may include a photograph of the registrant.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "child survivor privacy act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "child survivor privacy act"; provides protections for child victims and child witnesses; restricts information to the public regarding a child witness or child victim's identity or proceeding; defines child witness; provides that whenever practical, the same prosecutor, advocate, and/or social worker shall handle all aspects of a case involving an alleged child victim.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "go green schools act" to assist school districts in converting to renewable energy systems
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "go green schools act" to assist school districts in converting to renewable energy sources as a primary source of energy; directs NYSERDA to conduct a study and make recommendations for such purpose.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of autism
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of autism for purposes of the mental hygiene law.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to mental health care services for emergency dispatchers
sponsored.sum: Provides that a collective bargaining agreement or employment contract shall not require that an emergency dispatcher employed by a municipality obtain approval from, or provide notice to, a supervisor to access mental or behavioral health care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring CPR and AED training by youth league coaches
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring CPR and AED training by youth league coaches; requires youth league coaches to be trained in adult and child CPR and the use of an automated external defibrillator; provides current coaches have one year from the effective date of the law to receive such training; provides that a person who is unable to complete a training due to a physical disability may coach as long as a person who has completed a training is present at all times.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit for travel on certain roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit to 70 mph for travel on roadways that currently have a maximum speed limit of 65 mph.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding spina bifida to the definition of developmental disability
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding spina bifida to the definition of developmental disability in the mental hygiene law.

sponsored.t: Designates crimes of manslaughter that result in the death of a child class A-1 felonies
sponsored.sum: Designates crimes of manslaughter as class A-1 felonies when a defendant recklessly or with the intent to cause physical injury causes the death of a child.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Duane Lake, in the town of Duanesburg, county of Schenectady, to participate in the septic system replacement fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Duane Lake, in the town of Duanesburg, county of Schenectady, to participate in the septic system replacement fund.

sponsored.t: Allow a vehicle registration to transfer on death
sponsored.sum: Allow a vehicle registration to transfer on death at the election of the vehicle owner.

sponsored.t: Allows customers to decline the installation of smart meters
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "consumer utility meter choice protection act"; allows customers to decline the installation of smart meters without being liable for fees.

sponsored.t: Enacts "the rural caregiver relief act"; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts "the rural caregiver relief act"; provides a tax credit for unpaid family caregivers in an amount equal to $3,000 (Part A); establishes a workplace flexibility grant program to support informal caregivers by awarding grants to businesses who offer remote work options, paid leave and flexible schedules to employees who are informal caregivers (Part B); determines the training and assistance available to informal caregivers in rural areas by requiring the director of the aging to conduct a review (Part C); relates to the provision of a transportation assistance stipend for informal caregivers in rural areas of the state (Part D); makes an appropriation to the office for the aging to…

sponsored.t: Establishes a single registration requirement for non-commercial vehicles
sponsored.sum: Establishes a single registration requirement for non-commercial vehicles; provides that the registration for non-commercial vehicles shall not expire until the title of such motor vehicle is transferred to a new owner.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of failure to report a school safety threat
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of failure to report a school safety threat as a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Requires vessels used for certain watersports to display a flag
sponsored.sum: Requires vessels used for certain watersports that involve towing persons to display a flag.

sponsored.t: Ensures paid employees of the New York state division of military and naval affairs which perform fire response or fire rescue duties are eligible for equal benefits as other paid firefighters
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the definition of a paid firefighter to include firefighters employed by the division of military and naval affairs for the purpose of receiving certain benefits as other firefighters.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state window tinting safety and enforcement act"; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "New York state window tinting safety and enforcement act".

sponsored.t: Requires the department of state to make renewed appearance enhancement licenses and certificates and renewed barber licenses and certificates available on its website in a portable document format for download
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of state to make renewed appearance enhancement licenses and certificates and renewed barber licenses and certificates available on its website in a portable document format for download by the person whose license or certificate has been renewed.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to produce and publish a report on staffing at state-operated institutions under the jurisdiction of such office
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for people with developmental disabilities to produce and publish a report to assess the staffing and other issues causing the continued displacement of individuals with developmental disabilities from various state-operated institutions under the jurisdiction of the office for people with developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Provides a premium reduction for physicians who complete a training strategies course relating to emergency department visits for individuals with a developmental or intellectual disability
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to approve courses for eligible physicians, nurses and other staff that covers risk management strategies in emergency department visits for individuals with a developmental or intellectual disability; provides a premium reduction for physicians who complete such risk management strategies course.

sponsored.t: Establishes a direct support professional worker registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a direct support professional worker registry of persons who have successfully completed a direct support professional worker education or training program approved by the commissioner of mental health.

sponsored.t: Requires OPWDD to purchase and provide essential PPE to all mental health providers in the event of a declaration of a state emergency that relates to public health
sponsored.sum: Requires OPWDD to purchase and provide essential personal protection equipment to all direct support professionals, care recipients and group home providers in the event of a declaration of a state emergency that relates to public health.

sponsored.t: Relates to standards of proof for establishing that a student has a disability in the university of the state of New York or the city university of New York system
sponsored.sum: Relates to standards of proof for establishing that a student has a disability in the university of the state of New York or the city university of New York system including accepting documents as proof of a students' disability.

sponsored.t: Enacts the expanded in-home services funding act; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the expanded in-home services funding act to increase funding for expanded in-home services for the elderly; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Enacts the quiet hour public spaces inclusion act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "quiet hour public spaces inclusion act"; provides that every covered public building shall offer designated quiet hours during normal business hours; defines "quiet hours" as accommodations made for individuals with autism, post-traumatic stress disorder, sensory processing disorders and other related conditions during a designated time including reduced lighting, lower noise levels and limited use of loudspeakers and announcements.

sponsored.t: Relates to improving recruitment and retention of air traffic controllers in New York State
sponsored.sum: Relates to addressing staffing shortages and improving workforce stability by providing state-funded financial incentives for air traffic controllers working in New York State.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "no child left out inclusive playgrounds act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "no child left out inclusive playgrounds act"; requires newly built and renovated playgrounds to be accessible for children with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for minority-owned business enterprise participation for state contracts
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for minority-owned business enterprise participation for state contracts to include businesses with employee stock ownership plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting the communication rights of individuals with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting the communication rights of individuals with disabilities; provides that each person with a disability has the right to communicate in their preferred manner.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "9/11 first responders and survivors' emergency healthcare access act"; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts "the 9/11 first responders and survivors' emergency healthcare access act"; establishes the 9/11 first responders and survivors' emergency healthcare access fund to provide 9/11 first responders and survivors with funding for medical treatments, prescriptions, and essential care services when a federal claim is delayed, a federal benefit is under appeal and an urgent health-related need arises while awaiting federal response.

sponsored.t: Expands coverage for developmentally disabled persons past twenty-six years of age
sponsored.sum: Expands coverage for developmentally disabled persons past twenty-six years of age; prohibits insurance companies from wrongfully terminating contracts of developmentally disabled persons; requires recertification of such developmentally disabled person's condition once every five years.

sponsored.t: Permits a real property tax freeze to be granted to persons sixty-five years of age or older
sponsored.sum: Permits persons sixty-five years of age or older to be granted a real property tax freeze.

sponsored.t: Requires certain legal notices related to class actions be in a readable format
sponsored.sum: Requires certain legal notices related to class actions be in a readable format; provides penalties failing to comply with the requirements for legal notices.

sponsored.t: Establishes the human services wage commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the human services wage commission for the purpose of investigating whether the wages paid to human services workers are sufficient to provide adequate maintenance and to protect the health and welfare of employees; defines terms; provides for the duties of the commission; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sales tax holiday for food and non-alcoholic beverages sold at certain establishments during the second full week of February and the third full week of August
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sales tax holiday for food and non-alcoholic beverages sold at a restaurant, diner, or cafe licensed under article twenty-C of the agriculture and markets law during the second full week of February and the third full week of August.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Schenectady
sponsored.sum: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Schenectady.

sponsored.t: Relates to the registration of motor vehicles owned by the parent or guardian of a severely disabled person
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the parent or guardian of a severely disabled person to register a motor vehicle used for transporting a person with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the right of non-speaking developmentally and otherwise disabled persons to advocate for themselves in educational, medical, legal, and other decisions by using alternative forms of communication
sponsored.sum: Establishes the right of non-speaking developmentally and otherwise disabled individuals to advocate for themselves in educational, medical, legal, and other decisions by using alternative forms of communication, such as spelling boards, typing-based communication, sign language, and speech-generating devices.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "guaranteed reservation protection for rental car customers act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "guaranteed reservation protection for rental car customers act"; provides that a rental vehicle company shall not charge any authorized driver a rental rate higher than the rate quoted in such driver's reservation.

sponsored.t: Establishes a statewide residential families committee
sponsored.sum: Establishes a statewide residential families committee within the developmental disabilities advisory council.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "autism data privacy protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "autism data privacy protection act" which provides data protection for persons with autism.

sponsored.t: Establishes a blue envelope program for persons with mental health disorders, behavioral disorders and persons who are neurodivergent
sponsored.sum: Establishes a blue envelope program for persons with mental health disorders, behavioral disorders and persons who are neurodivergent to be provided with blue envelopes to keep their identification, vehicle registration, and other related documents to improve their safety during law enforcement interactions; requires the municipal police training council to promulgate rules and regulations requiring training and instruction for all police officers with respect to the blue envelope program.

sponsored.t: Provides cancer screening and treatment for retired volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides cancer screening and treatment for retired volunteer firefighters; defines retired volunteer firefighters; retroactively applies to retired volunteer firefighters.

sponsored.t: Establishes the disability access accountability commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the disability access accountability commission; provides membership, duties, and powers to the commission.

sponsored.t: Establishes the toll-free overnight hours pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the toll-free overnight hours pilot program to reduce traffic congestion during peak hours, provide economic relief to drivers and businesses, and encourage efficient freight operations by implementing toll-free travel during designated overnight hours on the New York state thruway; repeals certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes equitable tip pooling structures for counter service restaurants that pay all employees at or above minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Authorizes equitable tip pooling structures for counter service restaurants that pay all employees at or above minimum wage; authorizes tip pooling for service and non-service employees.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative approval of any utility rate or charge increase approved by the public service commission
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative approval of any utility rate or charge increase approved by the public service commission; provides that the legislature can approve, modify or rescind any rate or charge increase approved by the commission by concurrent resolution; provides that the legislature can review any rate or charge increase approved in the prior 12 months.

sponsored.t: Prohibits utilities from raising rates while reporting high profits and requires utilities to reinvest revenues into New York's energy infrastructure, safety, and reliability
sponsored.sum: Prohibits utilities from raising rates while reporting high profits; requires utilities to reinvest revenues into New York's energy infrastructure, safety, and reliability; requires the submission to the public service commission of a compliance report.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulating the operation of animal boarding kennels
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing, inspection and regulation of animal boarding kennels; authorizes the department of agriculture and markets to license, inspect and regulate animal boarding kennels.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring Medicaid coverage of FDA-approved GLP-1 receptor agonist medications for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring Medicaid coverage of FDA-approved GLP-1 receptor agonist medications for obesity, metabolic disorders, and autism-related compulsive eating behaviors.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of the care demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of the care demonstration program to March 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the closure or transfer of a state-operated individualized residential alternative
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of the requirement that upon the closure or transfer of a state-operated individualized residential alternative the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities shall provide appropriate and timely notification to the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, and appropriate representatives of impacted labor organizations, and shall make reasonable efforts to inform the affected workforce, residents and family members of the proposed closure or transfer plan.

sponsored.t: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual report on the activities of the council
sponsored.sum: Requires the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual report to the governor, temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly on the activities of the council, and to make such report public.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 44 Chapter 663 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7560-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to requiring the developmental disabilities advisory council to submit an annual report on the activities of the council" APPROVED This bill would require the developmental disabilities advisory coun- cil to submit an annual report that includes: information on the actions taken to foster public understanding and acceptance of developmental disabilities; recommendations made to the commissioner related to state- wide priorities and goals for services for individuals with develop- mental disabilities, and the implementation of the 5.07 plan; and any other actions taken by the council related to their duties. I support the goals of this legislation, which are to provide insight into the work of this important council. However, the…

sponsored.t: Requiring a petition in a summary proceeding to recover possession of real property in Schenectady to allege proof of compliance with local laws requiring rental residential property registration and licensure
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires a petition in a summary proceeding to recover possession of real property in the city of Schenectady to allege proof of compliance with local laws requiring rental residential property registration and licensure.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use tax in Schenectady county; extends such authority until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.
